Aninda Studio

অনিন্দ্য স্টুডিও

I make small, careful software, and the design system it is built on. Where something has a limit, the limit is written down here rather than left for you to find.

আমি ছোটো, যত্নে গড়া সফটওয়্যার বানাই। কোনো কিছুর সীমা থাকলে সেটা এখানেই লেখা থাকবে — লুকিয়ে রাখা হবে না।

What this studio is

Aninda Studio is one person: Aninda Sundar Howlader. I design and build software, and I write in two languages, English and Bangla, because both are first languages for the people I build for.

The rule I work to is that a claim gets measured before it is made. Contrast ratio — how far apart two colours are in brightness — was measured for every colour pairing in this system rather than judged by eye. Every page here was rendered in a real browser and then measured. Where a figure could not be checked against its own source, it is marked as unverified instead of being presented as fact.

That applies to this page too. It was rendered at three widths in all four themes, and the contrast of every piece of text on it was measured against the background it actually sits on.

Every state carries a word and a glyph

Colour is the third signal here and never the only one. A reader who cannot tell the five badges above apart by colour can still read which is which.

Card

A surface one step brighter than the page

It carries a shadow in the light theme and none in the dark ones, because a shadow on a dark ground reads as dirt rather than as height.

styles.css
.as-card {
  background-color: var(--as-surface-bright);
  box-shadow: var(--as-shadow-float);
}

Foundations 6

ColourরংEvery colour role across four themes, each with the contrast ratio it was measured at and the criterion it was measured against, over the seven surfaces they are measured against.
TypographyহরফOne scale of a perfect fourth, two scripts, a measured multiplier for Bangla and a floor it never goes below.
Space and shapeফাঁক ও আকারA 4 px scale in ten steps, and four radii. Everything in the system sits on one of them.
MotionগতিTwo durations and three easing curves. Things that move may overshoot; things that only change colour never do.
The marksচিহ্নThe mark in two weights, drawn in currentColor so it takes whatever theme it lands in.
Accessibilityঅভিগম্যতাTarget sizes with the guidance each one comes from, the anatomy of the focus ring, and what happens in forced colours — the mode where the operating system replaces every colour with its own.

Components 16

ButtonবাটনFour kinds, two sizes and an icon-only form, each with a label that says what will happen.
InputইনপুটA label, an optional hint, and an error that says what happened and then what to do next.
Selectবাছাই তালিকাA native select with a drawn arrow, so the arrow follows the theme instead of the operating system.
Checkbox and radioচেকবক্স ও রেডিওNative controls at 24 px, wrapped in a label so the words are part of the target.
Textareaলেখার ঘরYou can drag it taller but never wider, so the line length stays comfortable to read.
Badgeব্যাজFive meanings, each carrying a glyph and a word so the colour is the third signal and never the only one.
Cardকার্ডA surface a step brighter than the page, with a shadow in the light theme and none in the dark ones.
Alertবার্তাFour kinds. Each says what happened, then what happens next, and never blames the reader.
Dialogডায়ালগA real dialog element over a dimmed backdrop, with the destructive action named rather than called OK.
TableটেবিলRow headers, a caption saying what the numbers are, and a sideways scroll when the table is wider than the space.
Tabsট্যাবThe selected tab is bold, underlined and marked with aria-selected. Three signals, one of which is a colour.
NavনেভিগেশনVertical and horizontal. The current item carries a bar, a heavier weight and aria-current.
BreadcrumbপথরেখাThe last item is not a link, because you are already on it.
Toastটোস্টA short message with a dismiss button that has a name of its own, not only a cross.
Empty stateযখন কিছু নেইSays what is missing, and then exactly what to do about it.
Code blockকোড ব্লকAninda Mono, a horizontal scroll rather than a wrap, and a copy button that says what it copies.

PricingদামThree plans, with the recommended one marked by a badge and a word.

Installing the token packages

Not published yet

On 2026-08-18 I checked the npm registry and the Python Package Index, and neither holds these packages. They are built and they work from a local checkout. The two commands below are what will work once they are published, and I would rather show you that plainly than let you find out at the terminal.

For a web project

terminal
npm install aninda-studio-tokens
app.css
@import "aninda-studio-tokens/css";

Version 1.0.0, licensed Apache-2.0. The package also exports one stylesheet per theme, and the tokens as DTCG format data.

For a Python project

terminal
pip install aninda-studio-tokens
app.py
from aninda_studio_tokens import css, css_path, THEMES

print(THEMES)              # ['light', 'dark', 'hc-light', 'hc-dark']
print(css('dark')[:40])    # the dark theme's stylesheet text
print(css_path())          # the path to the complete one

The same values, the same four themes, read from the same source data.

Using them without a package

The stylesheet is plain CSS custom properties. Copy tokens.css into your project, link it, and every value below is available to you.

index.html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="tokens.css">
anything.css
.panel {
  background-color: var(--as-surface-bright);
  color: var(--as-ink);
  border-radius: var(--as-radius-card);
}

Generated by 11_site/build.py from the files named on this page. Editing this page by hand is undone by the next build.

  • Literata — SIL OFL 1.1, subset
  • Noto Serif Bengali — SIL OFL 1.1, subset
  • Aninda Mono — SIL OFL 1.1, subset and renamed
  • Aninda Mono (desktop) — SIL OFL 1.1, subset and renamed

Literata and Noto Serif Bengali keep their own names. The monospace face is a subset of IBM Plex Mono renamed to Aninda Mono, because Plex is a Reserved Font Name and subsetting is a modification under clause 3 of the SIL Open Font Licence 1.1. Each licence file sits beside its font in 08_components/fonts/.

The design tokens and this site are licensed Apache-2.0. Copyright 2026 Aninda Sundar Howlader.

Bangla appears only where an approved string exists. The spelling rules and their sources are in 06_type/BANGLA-STANDARD.md, which governs; the strings themselves are in 06_type/bangla-strings.json, which is the file this build reads and which carries the rule number or dictionary page each string rests on. Everywhere else the text stays in English rather than being translated by guesswork, and those places are listed in this build's output.
